conclusion: All 19 native action phases completed including release, withdrawal and settling. The task failed: actual final bear nodes and mass COM are outside the bag; physical limits passing does not establish containment.

actual_every_step_soft.sampling_scope: Soft summary at each recorded integration step; full geometry at saved frames.

actual_guard.scope: IPC soft-coupling STC feedback; excludes native Genesis rigid-contact force
limitations: Positive finger-axis projections plus material proximity are grip evidence, not force-closure proof.

actual_jointrate_thresholds.source: config.validation or conservative audit defaults; not robot manufacturer limits

rate_scope: Every-step actual joint positions differentiated by numpy.gradient; phase masks use the same full-run derivatives. Separate from planned reference 0.35/0.5 gates and yaw continuous reference bounds.

limitations: External robot mesh hashes are measured at this review, not established as startup hashes.

Hash consistency proves recorded inputs match the manifest; it does not prove physical correctness or task success.

final_material_readback.scope: Per-scene pre-initialization FEM shell coefficient conversion
final_material_readback.note: Native attribute readback was taken during pre-initialization and persisted in the final report; this is not a second end-time material-buffer readback.

final_contact_sampling.method: Discrete bag vertex, edge-midpoint and triangle-centroid winding/distance samples

final_low_region_pointwise_diagnostic.scope: Actual pointwise degree relative to two coherently closed physical-body triangle chains. Does not certify embedded/nonintersecting body or whole tetrahedron volume.

actual_insert_low_region_existing_indepe.scope: Only points below every rim vertex and the virtual fan cap; cap exists for analysis only. Not whole-body final containment proof.

limitations: Integration-step and saved-frame observations do not certify continuous collision freedom.
